reviewSummary: ACCEPT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The mode-0444 subject remained at the required digest on D-291 HEAD. All 78 recorded filesystem pins and all 67 structured path/digest assertions reproduce; the subject plus all 67 recorded JSON inputs pass duplicate-key and non-RFC-constant rejection. Frozen G21 leftover-join.v12, occupancy v4, and doctor-actor leftovers v12 and v11 remain at their dispatched digests and modes. V13 preserves v12's exact seven-obligation partition, singleton leftoverDesign [OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING], empty closure list, occupancy-v4 custody, named corpus, passProperty, summary, and fixture/corpus measurements; it updates the DR-114 sentinel to current doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, whose seven-member leftover set is list-identical to v11's and whose OBL-JOIN-FX-EXECUTION flag remains false. G21 leftover v12 remains current at draft time and becomes historical only after this successor is recorded. The finding ledger retains one findingDisposition ID and five accepted applied IDs at their historical landing versions, adds no lands array, and re-lands nothing. The candidate binds NOTHING, executes nothing, occupies no identifier, invents no prohibited bytes or identifier, changes no status token or required-now count, opens no Class A, satisfies no row, edits neither protected file, and authorizes no implementation. One inherited G21-v3 shorthand is recorded as a non-finding observation because structural context and byte-identical referents eliminate any false reading.
